reason: Compiles, but the supplied strftime maximum length is ignored. The bounded-buffer probe expects zero for a 19-character date with maxsize=5, and fails. The C binding omits VALUE on size_t maxsize. The tm layout also needs platform ABI review before exposing mktime and timezone-dependent formatting; the source declares only nine integers. Deferred rather than publishing a limited example that hides these issues. A direct sandbox ABI probe confirms sizeof(struct tm)=56 bytes versus c_sizeof(time_f tm)=36 bytes.
